data.one_liner: Google Maps location picker for Flutter with Places API search and typed addresses.
data.what_it_does: A map location picker supporting Android, iOS, and web. It lets users search for places using Places API (New) autocomplete, tap or drag a marker, or use centre-pin picking while returning a typed address result.
use_when: You need a drop-in location or address picker for delivery, ride-hailing, or checkout forms using Google Maps.
You want support for Android, iOS, and web without writing custom geocoding and search UI from scratch.
avoid_when: Your application targets desktop platforms (macOS, Windows, Linux) where google_maps_flutter lacks implementation.
You require an alternative mapping provider like Mapbox or OpenStreetMap instead of Google Maps.
strengths: Supports both marker dragging and centre-pin delivery-app patterns out of the box.
Built-in Places API (New) autocomplete search requiring no CORS proxy on web.
Provides typed error handling and a comprehensive programmatic controller.
weaknesses: Tied exclusively to Google Maps and specific Google Cloud APIs (requires billing and API keys setup).
No desktop support due to underlying map plugin limitations.
data.setup_notes: Requires enabling Google Maps and Places APIs in the Cloud console, configuring API keys in AndroidManifest.xml, AppDelegate.swift, and index.html, plus adding location permissions for mobile platforms.
